messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR that adds small preflight cert-validation scripts for offline/private installs (PowerShell + sh). Needs docs + security review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822

maria: Summary: - ps1 + sh scripts that verify cert chain against provided CA bundle, check SHA256 checksums, and run an example KMS TLS handshake using openssl s_client as a fallback for air-gapped sites. Also included a tiny systemd unit example to run a local cert-cache helper.

alex: skimmed — overall good. pls add an explicit warning about private key handling and show the minimal file perms (chmod 600 / Set-Acl) next to the PS snippet. also include example output for a failing chain so users know what to expect. :+1:

sam: left inline comments on the PR. For PowerShell use `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` rather than older cmdlets. Also we still have customers on PS5; can we add a 1-line fallback that uses .NET if Get-FileHash doesn't exist?

maria: good call. i'll add a fallback function that attempts `Get-FileHash` then falls back to `[System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()` if needed.

tina: can docs-ci safely run these scripts? we shouldn't have CI hit real KMS endpoints. suggest adding a `--dry-run` flag that validates bundles and checksums but skips network handshakes. also add a small optional section showing how to run the TLS handshake against a local test server.

infra-bot: docs-ci: build for PR 4822 succeeded — artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/4822/ (contains sample script output and lint report) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks infra-bot. i'll add `--dry-run` and a `--no-network` env var. i'll also include the testserver instructions (python -m http.server + openssl s_server example) in an appendix.

jeff: small nit: rename variable `$bundlePath` -> `$certBundlePath` in the PS script to reduce confusion with other "bundle" references elsewhere in the doc.

sam: another suggestion: include a one-line pkcs11 check for HSM users: `pkcs11-tool --list-objects -l -k` and note it requires the pkcs11 provider path. mark it as optional and platform-specific.

maria: will add pkcs11 snippet and label it optional. also adding a short note on how to pass the PKCS#11 lib path and a security blurb about not committing lib paths/credentials.

tina: also include a tiny tracer check for commonly blocked ports (`tcp/443`, `tcp/8443`) and DNS resolution for the KMS hostname (nslookup/dig) — put it in a troubleshooting section, optional.

maria: added tracer checks and a "When things fail" troubleshooting list with common fixes (eg, MTU issues, NAT + SNI, captive proxies). also included example failure outputs for chain validation, expired cert, and mismatched SAN.

security: reviewed and acked. added a paragraph reminding to rotate ephemeral certs used in CI and to avoid logging private DER blobs. also asked to add a pointer to the Key Handling policy.

maria: updated PR with changes: fallback PS5 support, `--dry-run`, renamed variables, pkcs11 snippet, tracer checks, example outputs, and security notes. pinged @docs-owners for final sign-off.

alex: quick pass done — LGTM from docs perspective.

infra-bot: docs-ci: all checks passed for PR 4822 (lint, linkcheck, code-sample run in dry-run mode).

maria: merged after approvals and green CI. closing the loop here — thanks everyone for quick reviews! :tada:

maria: follow-up: i'll open a tiny follow-up PR to add a short Windows-specific note about using `Set-AuthenticodeSignature` for signed scripts, and link to our installer FAQ.

sam: thx — looks great. saved the sample scripts into the internal snippet repo as well.

maria: archived artifacts and pushed a release note entry under docs changelog. thread closed.
